name: Tab Group Sessions
description: tmux-like sessions on top of Chrome Tab Groups, fully keyboard driven.

_execute_action.description: Picker · Leader menu (or search, see Options)

10-open-picker.description: Picker · Open (falls back to a window in fullscreen)

11-open-picker-window.description: Picker · Open in a separate window

12-open-leader.description: Picker · Open the leader menu (works in fullscreen)

22-last-group.description: Group · Toggle to the last focused group

23-move-tab.description: Group · Move the current tab to another / a new group

26-close-group.description: Group · Close the current group (asks first)

27-set-group-color.description: Group · Change the current group colour

28-move-group-left.description: Group · Move the current group left

29-move-group-right.description: Group · Move the current group right

30-next-tab-in-group.description: Tab · Next tab in the current group (wraps)

31-prev-tab-in-group.description: Tab · Previous tab in the current group (wraps)

41-goto-tab-1.description: Tab · Go to tab 1 of the current group

42-goto-tab-2.description: Tab · Go to tab 2 of the current group

43-goto-tab-3.description: Tab · Go to tab 3 of the current group

44-goto-tab-4.description: Tab · Go to tab 4 of the current group

45-goto-tab-5.description: Tab · Go to tab 5 of the current group

46-goto-tab-6.description: Tab · Go to tab 6 of the current group

47-goto-tab-7.description: Tab · Go to tab 7 of the current group

48-goto-tab-8.description: Tab · Go to tab 8 of the current group

49-goto-tab-9.description: Tab · Go to the last tab of the current group

50-restore-snapshot.description: Recovery · Restore from a snapshot (only adds what is missing)

51-merge-duplicate-groups.description: Recovery · Merge groups with the same name into this window (from all windows)

52-reopen-closed-group.description: Recovery · Reopen the last group closed from the keyboard
